_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution: a mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so `s.stdio.semio.video`'s oracle registration and catalog live here rather than in a shared manifest. `s.stdio.semio.video` is a semio-NATIVE format, so its reference is a second IMPLEMENTATION written in another language from the committed grammars rather than a third-party package.

oracles.rationale:
No third-party library in any ecosystem reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio` envelope, so the second producer THE STANDARD requires is a second IMPLEMENTATION in another language. `../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-semio-video/🐍️component.py` is that implementation: the `semio <envelope-id>.dsl v1` preamble, the whole `document = artifact-mark schema-line streams-line` grammar in both directions — `stream`, `sample`, `rational`, `kind = V|A|S` and `bool = 0|1` included — and all nine verbs of this subset's vocabulary together with their inverses, written in Python from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/📝️text/📖️.grammar.semio`, `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/📝️text/📖️.grammar.semio` and the envelope section of `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🧬️semio/🦀️.rs`, importing nothing from and transliterating nothing of the Rust it judges. The grammars' own notes distinguish the two uses of the `hex` macro — a `schema`/`codec` leaf is the lowercase hex of a UTF-8 string (`68323634` is `h264` in the committed artifact) while a sample `data` leaf is an opaque byte run — and the reading is pinned by byte-exact re-emission of the committed file. `package` is deliberately the empty string: the implementation needs no distribution, so it contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json` and nothing to the import-purity probe. The container route was surveyed again and still rejected on the merits rather than for absence — `mp4` 0.14, `riff` 2.0, `pymp4` and `mp4box.js` read and write CONTAINERS, while this snapshot is container-neutral and payload-opaque, so every kind but `set-sample-data` would have to be projected through a container write that invents a track id, an edit list and a codec-configuration record the snapshot does not carry.

UNDER PROTOCOL V2 this registration is classified `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENTAL oracle that does not discharge `semio-v1-video-mutate`'s external-oracle requirement for its 9-kind mutation vocabulary; a qualifying third-party reference (`third-party-library` / `third-party-cli` / `standards-reference-tool`) is still owed.

[2026-09-02, D1 — SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION] Promoted from cross-semio-implementation to verified-native-second-implementation: this artifact is semio-native (isSemioNativeArtifact), this reference's own third-party survey above (kept verbatim) already names what was checked and declined, its python implementation differs from the Rust subject, and it covers 100% of this manifest's 1 capability/capabilities with 1 committed fixture vector(s). See .🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️09/☀️02/SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION/📓️d1-native-oracle-discharge.md.
